utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We still need to sort the tool table, check a few repairs, and see who’s bringing what. I’m on it and can help get everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—thanks, Gus. I’m only hearing bits and pieces, so I’m glad you’re lining everything up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wonderful — I’ll keep telling folks to come by the community center Sunday. Looks like we’re really building a good little crew for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Tess—thank you. I’m glad we’ve got the word out and a good crew coming Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep chatting it up so more neighbors come by the community center Sunday. A good crew will make the repair drive a real success!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — I could really use help sorting the repair list and figuring out who’s available. I’m a bit overwhelmed, so keeping it simple would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep it simple and start with the repair list plus who’s available. If you want, send me the must-haves first and I’ll check the bins for those.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, thank you. I’ll send the must-haves first and keep it brief.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like the timing and route nailed down first so I can plan the load without any surprises.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check the timing and route, then I’ll circle back so we’re all set before anyone loads up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — once you’ve got the timing and route, let me know and I’ll plan my load around it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: 6:30 still works for me — I’ll bring the flashlight and screwdriver, and I’ll help load the tools and donations once I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, 6:30 works for me too. I’ll bring the drill, screwdrivers, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll be there at 6:30 and help load the tools and donations when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure—send me the time slots and the repair list, and I’ll help line up volunteers around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Faye. Send me the time slots and repair list, and I’ll see if I can help line up a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll keep an eye out for them and work it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there at 10 with the drill, screwdrivers, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, that should help a lot — I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we need. Just let me know if the list changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do — if anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still waiting on the latest details before I confirm anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along the latest as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update before I confirm anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, the repair drive is still on. Just let me know which location needs attention first, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can start with the school site first. I’ll bring the drill, screwdrivers, and work gloves at 10.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve logged the school site as first, and I’ll note 10 for the tools and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out—what still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — thanks, Rey! I’ll keep spreading the word so we’ve got a good crew at 10.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Glad to help — just let me know if anything else needs doing before 10.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive and make sure the plan gets around.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I can help spread the word too. Just send me the time and list when you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll send you the time and list as soon as I have them, and we’ll keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, the repair drive? I might’ve missed the details—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, I’m just confirming it’s still on — are we still doing the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, as far as I know it’s still on—I just may have missed any new updates. If you’ve got the latest details, send them my way and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it’s still on—we’re just filling the gaps as we go. I’m keeping the list updated so we can keep moving ahead.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good—what gaps are still open? I can help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—I'll check the list and tell you the biggest gaps. Offhand, we still need a few repair supplies, but I’ll confirm exactly what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted, and I’m spreading the word to see who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just ping me when you know what’s needed, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll check who still needs help and let you know what tools or supplies would be most useful.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still sorting the list, but a few people to help with the fixes would really ease things. I’ll send the details over as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli — once you send the details, I’ll line up a few helpers and keep everything organized for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I really appreciate that—I’ll get the list to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — once you send the time slots and repair list, I’ll help line everything up around school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send the time slots and repair list right away, and I’ll spread the word to a few more helpers too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Quinn — I’ll get things lined up once the list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to know the route, timing, and what we’re hauling first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — I’m still waiting on the latest details, so I can’t confirm the route, timing, or load yet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll see if I can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so what’s still left to fix for the drive? If I hear any supply updates, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands, and I’ll text you the time and drop-off spot as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll wait for your text and pass along any updates I hear too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scatterbrained today, but I can still come by and help with whatever needs fixing; just remind me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect—thanks, Oren. It’s at the community center on Sunday now, and honestly any help with fixes would be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — Sunday at the community center works. Just point me to whatever needs fixing, and I’ll lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m putting it together now and I’ll send it over shortly, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara — I’ll watch for it and review it right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m sending it over now, Leo — thanks for waiting.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep everyone posted and pass along the latest repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik. I’m noting the latest details now, and I’ll watch for anything that needs attention first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep everyone posted and make sure the repair drive plan gets around.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — 9 a.m. still works for me. I’ll be there to help sort donations and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just confirming, the repair drive is still definitely on, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it’s definitely still on. I’ll be there at 9 a.m. to help sort donations and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Got it — I’ll be there at 10 with the drill, screwdrivers, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, that covers the essentials — I’ll bring the tool sorter and help set things up. See you at 10.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, see you at 10 — I’ll have the drill, screwdrivers, and gloves ready.
